Fields.Name: Stream
Fields.Description:
The index of this member into the current layout.

Used to combine members into a single layout.

Primarily used in edge-compressed PS3 models due to positions needing to be separate.

Fields.Name: Special Modifier
Fields.Description: Value of -32768 denotes this member isn't stored with the vertex buffer due to Speedtree.

Fields.Name: Layout Type
Fields.Description: Format used to store this member.

Fields.Name: Index
Fields.Description: For semantics that may appear more than once such as UVs, which one this member is.

Fields.Name: Size
Fields.Description: The size of this member's ValueType, in bytes.
